'''Kallin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] Commander of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[war against Zakuul]]. Following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]] Empress [[Vaylin]] and the formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3629 BBY]], Kallin, connected to the former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]], became an outspoken critic of the Alliance. Eventually Kallin and his group of supporters enacted a plan for a false-flag operation, planning to bomb the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] and make it look like the Alliance was responsible. Basing their operation in [[The Works/Legends|the Works]], they sliced multiple combat droids to use them for their cause, obtained necessary explosives from evidence lockups and purchased the rest from local criminal groups.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: Attack on the Senate Tower}}</ref>

However, the Eternal Alliance learned of Kallin's plan and moved to [[Battle in the Works|intercept]] him and his followers. The Alliance operatives tracked him to his base in the Works, where Kallin eventually dismissed the threat, believing the local [[Cthon/Legends|cthons]] to be a sufficient defense. However, the Alliance fought through and defeated Kallin's Lieutenant [[Raena]] before engaging Kallin himself. Kallin put up a fight, but was eventually overwhelmed and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Kallin appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as the final boss of the "Divided We Fall" Uprising, which was released in Game Update 5.1: Defend the Throne.
